ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with high-intensity (white) clusters concentrated at distal margins; approximate 15:85 white-to-black pixel ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast contiguous white mottling localized at the distal tips of both lobes, more extensive on the right lobe distal edge; isolated high-intensity focal spots visible on the central-right dark surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel-angle of approximately 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks is significant relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curve tapering toward pointed, upward-oriented distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of discrete white circular pixel clusters (diameter <5px) on the dark ventral surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertical light-grey linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge on the right lobe and center-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular erosion and jagged indentations along the trailing edge topography; prominent vertical linear scarring on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical jaggedness of the trailing edge on the right lobe compared to the left lobe.
